name: 41-google-roles-no-system-prompt
description:
useSysPrompt false, so nothing is shifted into system_instruction and the leading system turn is instead rewritten to 'user' (:462-463). The model string 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite' matches the second arm of the no-prefill test (:457), so the trailing assistant turn is rewritten to 'user' too (:466) and then merges into the same turn as the two other messages with '

'. Expected: system_instruction.parts = []; contents = [{'role':'user','parts':[{'text':'SYS

U1

A1'}]}]; mutated messages all carry role 'user'.
